questions.text:
Find all real numbers \(x\) in \([0,2\pi)\) such that
\[
\tan x+\cot x=2\sec 2x.
\]

Let
\[
f(x)=\sec x+\csc x.
\]
Find the minimum value of \(f(x)\) over all real \(x\) for which it is defined.

How many vertical asymptotes does the graph of
\[
y=\tan(2x)+\cot(3x)
\]
have on the interval \((0,\pi)\)?

Determine all real \(x\) satisfying
\[
\sec x-\tan x=\csc x-\cot x.
\]

A function of the form
\[
y=a\tan\big(k(x-b)\big)
\]
has consecutive vertical asymptotes at \(x=\frac{\pi}{12}\) and \(x=\frac{5\pi}{12}\), and its graph passes through \(\left(\frac{\pi}{4},-3\right)\). Find \(a\), \(k\), and one possible value of \(b\).
